## CONFOTUR Law (Law 158-01)

The CONFOTUR tax incentive program grants exemptions for up to 15 years on qualifying tourism-related properties:
- 0% title transfer tax (normally 3%)
- 0% annual property tax / IPI (normally 1% above ~$168,000 USD)
- 0% income tax on rental income in approved condo-hotel setups
- Eligible areas: Punta Cana, Cap Cana, Las Terrenas, Puerto Plata, select Santo Domingo projects
- Exemptions transfer to new buyers upon resale after 5 years

## Buying Process for Foreigners

1. Select property (no visa/residency required)
2. Sign promise of sale with deposit
3. Due diligence and title search (attorney: $1,500-3,000)
4. Sign final deed before notary
5. Register title with Registro de Titulos
- Timeline: 30-60 days
- Closing costs: 3-5% (transfer tax waived on CONFOTUR properties)
- Documents needed: passport, proof of funds, Dominican tax ID (RNC)

## Financing Options

- Dominican banks: 15-25 year terms, 8-12% interest, 30-40% down
- Developer direct financing: 5-10 year terms, 10-30% down
- Banks: Banreservas, Popular, BHD Leon
- Pre-approval timeline: 2-3 weeks

## Annual Ownership Costs (typical $300,000 condo)

- Property tax (IPI): 1% above $168,000 (waived 15 years with CONFOTUR)
- HOA/maintenance: $150-500/month
- Insurance: $500-2,000/year
- Utilities: $100-300/month
- Property management (if rented): 15-25% of rental income
- Total: $8,000-15,000 USD/year excluding mortgage
